macro.what: Outside-world witness: Nasdaq, S&P 500, VIX, US yields and the dollar (risk-on / risk-off), known only from the next day

onchain.what: On-chain witness: Bitcoin and Ethereum flowing into / out of exchanges, and exchange balances

sectors.what: Sector witness: money rotating between AI, memes, layer-1s, DeFi and exchange tokens

global.what: Compass global-markets witness: US, European and Asian stocks, the dollar, gold, oil, NVIDIA and chips, Coinbase, and how tightly Bitcoin follows stocks right now

mood.what: Compass mood witness: the crypto Fear & Greed index and the options market's fear gauge (implied volatility), and how fast they are changing

flows.what: Compass money-flow witness: dollar stablecoin supply growing or shrinking (new money arriving in / leaving crypto)

book.what: Order-book witness: how much money has been waiting to buy versus to sell near the price over the last days, and whether the book is getting thinner (Binance's own archive since 2023, one day behind)

liq.what: Liquidation witness: how many longs and shorts were forcibly closed yesterday and over the last week, per coin and market-wide (Binance, Bybit and OKX, history since 2020)

shock.what: Shock witness: how unusual the market's last moves were (what usually follows a shock like this)

recorder.what: Recorder witness: liquidations, order-book and order-flow imbalance, live funding (own server)
recorder.state: recording; needs ~21 days of history (5 so far)

whales.what: Whale witness: the largest Hyperliquid accounts' positions
